The tweaked hamstring suffered by Alex Lambert, in the 200m gave John Wells the responsibility of running the A string 400m. This he did with a PB of 53.3 to take an excellent second place.

Not only have the Lambert boys featured in all of our young athletes' teams with father Jon as Team Manager, but there is artistic talent as well. 18 year-old Alex has designed an eye-catching poster and brochure which is being used in schools across South London in our 2001 recruitment drive.

Racing at Bexley on 1st March in the Cambridge Harriers Winter League 5k, 17 year-old Alex Wright, barely into the Under 20 category, not only won the race from Nick Silvester of Aldershot, Farnham & District by two seconds, he also ducked under our best ever U20 time for the distance.
The team wasn’t as strong as we’d have liked – but there were some good performances – especially from younger short stagers Joe van der Toorn and Alex Bodin – worthy of a place in the A team.

And while John Hall has been mopping up records at the top end of the age group, Alex Wright has been busy again in the Under 20 category. For the fifth time he improved our 5k Race Walking Club Record.
